scaling_plan: Contract scaling plans on Elite Daily/Elite Access funded accounts; Live scales up to 5 live accounts

notes: Activation fee only on Elite Access ($139/$189/$259/$359 by size) and X-Daily Spark ($189). Elite Daily, Instant and Ignite have none. EAs and bots aren't allowed. There's a 10-second minimum trade time rule. Evaluation subscriptions renew monthly on the same calendar date.
